name: Xtile Firefox By Xenlism
description: 1x1 app launcher tile: centered icon, app name at the bottom, and a card background auto-tinted from the app's own icon color. Base widget of the Xtile series - defaults to Firefox, but the .desktop file can be swapped via Browse in settings. Xtile Chrome/Terminal/GIMP/Inkscape are the same widget with only their config.json defaults changed.
author: Nattapong Pullkhow
